C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No 516
14/8/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
14th August 1916.

POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
A memorial service in honour of the late Chen Chi Mei and other revolutionaries was held in a mat shed specially erected for the purpose in the grounds of the International Institute at 2 p.m. 13th inst. There were scrolls hung all over the shed eulogising the virtues of the deceased. There were about 3,000 persons present, including Huang Hsin, Wu Ting Fang, Ho Hai Ming 胡漢民, Tan Thim Zeu 戴天仇 formerly editor of defunct Ming Jau Pao, Tsang Tiu Yih 章太炎 formerly editor of Seu Pau 蘇報 and recently released from prison in Peking, Dan Zung Voong 譚人鳳, Military and Civil Governor of Hunan, Tsa Nyeu Ban 蔡元培, ex-Minister of Education. The first six named made speeches describing the career of Chen Chi Mei and other revolutionaries connected with this port. The speakers praised the work of the dead heroes, and impressed on their hearers the necessity of carrying on the political campaign until a stable government had been established in Peking. The service was very orderly, and terminated at 4.45 p.m.

Some officers and men who were dismissed from the Chapel Police in 1913, have now formed a society advocating their re-instatement and the dismissal of the northern men who took their place. The headquarters of this society are in Yoong You Li alleyway, Rue Wagner, French Town.

Five houses were destroyed by fire to the north of Stone Bridge in Chapel this morning.

The newly appointed Civil Governor of Kwangtung Province Chu Ching Loy 朱慶瀾 arrived in Shanghai this morning by railway from Nankin.

Your obedient servant,

[Signature]
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

刑事侦缉处
情报官登记处
第 516 号
1916年8月14日

上海工部局。
1916年8月14日。

警务处，
（侦探科）

先生：

本月13日下午2时，在万国函授学校（International Institute）院内特搭的草棚内，举行了追悼陈其美及其他革命志士的纪念仪式。草棚四周挂满了颂扬逝者美德的挽联。出席者约3000人，其中包括黄兴、伍廷芳、胡汉民、戴天仇（前《民报》编辑，该报已停刊）、章太炎（前《苏报》编辑，近期刚从北京监狱获释）、谭人凤（湖南军民政长）、蔡元培（前教育总长）。前述六人先后发表演说，叙述陈其美及与本埠有关的其他革命志士的生平事迹。演讲者赞扬了已故英雄们的功绩，并向听众强调，在北京建立起稳定政府之前，必须继续开展政治运动。仪式秩序井然，于下午4时45分结束。

一些在1913年被教堂巡捕房解职的警员和巡捕，现已组成一个社团，主张恢复他们的职务，并罢免取代他们职位的北方人。该社团总部设在法租界华格纳路（Rue Wagner）永裕里弄堂内。

今晨，闸北石桥以北有五间房屋被大火焚毁。

新任广东省省长朱庆澜今晨乘火车从南京抵达上海。

您忠实的仆人，

[签名]
首席侦探督察长。

警察总监。
